_doc: Public, machine-readable claim ledger for muntin.digital. Every externally-verifiable factual claim used across the library, paired with its primary public source and the date it was last checked. Generated from data/sourced-claims.json by scripts/build-claims-json.mjs — do not edit by hand. Operator-experience claims (first-hand, no public URL) are documented at https://muntin.digital/about/#timeline.

Muntin Ledger is free while in private beta; general availability is November 13, 2026. Operators who join the founding list before launch get the founding rate: three months free, then $19 a month for as long as they stay. Pricing is posted in writing at ledger.muntin.digital.
Mailchimp email tier monthly cost
Menus lag supplier costs: U.S. full-service menu prices rose about 4.4% year-over-year as of mid-2025, while wholesale food costs remained far above pre-pandemic levels (the source cites 36%+).

Operators are advised to revisit menu pricing in smaller increments roughly every six months rather than infrequent large jumps, because a dish costed six months earlier may have drifted significantly as supplier prices move.

The Muntin Cost Index put wholesale ribeye near $11.59 per pound as of June 5, 2026 (sourced from USDA Livestock Mandatory Reporting), flagged flat within its normal weekly range despite an upward two-year trend.
claims.source_name: Muntin Cost Index (data/cost-index.json, generated from verified sources only)
